opening: My skin and the whites of my eyes have turned yellow.
The fever and chills started 5 days ago.
Three months ago I had my gallbladder removed by keyhole surgery.
The gallstones caused an infection of the bile ducts, cholangitis, and that's why my gallbladder was taken out.

opening.text: I'm Asian, and three months ago I had my gallbladder removed by keyhole surgery because the gallstones caused an infection of the bile ducts, cholangitis. Since then, I've had a fever and chills that started 5 days ago. Also, my skin and the whites of my eyes have turned yellow, which started 2 days ago.
